description: T-5123 (SPEC-0039 E6 and Design 7, hand shape; references.md 'UNVERIFIED: a delete of every data row of two or more tables at once'): one delete_row of rows 4-7 (count 4), every data row of two tables side by side over the same sheet rows. Sales on S!B3:C7 (header B3:C3 Region/Qty, data rows 4-7 Qty 1,2,4,8); Other on S!E3:F7 (header E3:F3 Key/Val, data rows 4-7 Val 10,20,40,80). Does each table keep one cleared data row (rows 5-7 deleted), or only one of them? S!H4:H8 hold the marks r4..r8 beside the tables and S!H10 99 below them. Sheet F holds A1 =S!H10, A2 FORMULATEXT(A1) (how far the cells below move), A3 =ROWS(Sales), A4 =SUM(Sales[Qty]), A5 =ROWS(Other), A6 =SUM(Other[Val]), A7 =ROW(Other[#Headers]), A8 =SUM(S!C4:C7), A9 FORMULATEXT(A8), A10 the plain sum of Other's Val data, A11 FORMULATEXT(A10), and B1:B5 =INDEX(S!H:H,4..8), the marks left in sheet rows 4-8 (a whole-column reference a row delete does not move: which sheet rows went).
